question: Can an opt-in source-free readout infer one four-choice public intermediate wiring from public sequential traces and reuse two separately fully witnessed opaque-action truth functions to propose an unobserved two-step outcome, without mutating native state?
hypothesis: Two genuinely different public structural traces can uniquely constrain a fixed four-wiring grammar and permit a tentative two-action composite forecast on an unwitnessed input; ambiguous or contradictory traces must abstain or reject.
input_visibility: Only complete native fixture-witnessed primitive action signatures, public starting views, first outcomes, public second-stage views, second outcomes, and opaque action IDs; no hidden law, role or phase.
source_integrity: The native fixture readout and caller-supplied structural traces are engineering-only. A SHA pin is not authenticated intervention custody, and trace chaining is not source-authenticated.
controls: existing native exact observed primitive signature readout
independent fixed-four-wiring conventional symbolic control given the same traces and functions
corrupt primitive outcome and harness metadata negative
frozen_test_cases: two traces select one wiring and forecast novel state; parity with symbolic control
no trace and one distinct trace abstain
inconsistent structures and contradictory duplicates reject
query already witnessed cannot count as transfer
tampered primitive outcome and leaked role/phase rejected
type aliases, duplicate source IDs and capacity guard reject
repeat deterministic with no state mutation
success: Focused engineering tests pass without oracle labels, native mutation, or unsupported causal assertions; full exact-source dual-OS regression remains a separate requirement.
fail: Missing abstention, false source-authentication or action-authorization flag, incorrect wire selection, oracle metadata ingestion, capacity overflow or native-state mutation.
scientific_boundary: This cannot prove discovery of unfamiliar causal graphs, learned structural trace custody, generalization to unseen external IDs, autonomous intervention choice, scientific gain or transfer above equally informed symbolic inference. Requires separately approved preregistered scored source study.
